# Contract: flaky-test-killer

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Measure intermittent failures with confidence intervals, stress likely causes, find polluters, and prove a root-cause fix with before/after rates.

## Use it for
- "this test is flaky"
- "passes locally, fails in CI"

## Not for
- add retries (refused as a fix)

## Accepted inputs
A test command.

## Deliverables
Before/after flake rates with intervals, stressor sweep, polluter, evidence log.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- Node.js 18.19+

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Many test runs.

## Workflow
1. Reproduce and measure
2. Run alone vs in the suite vs in parallel
3. Sweep the stressors
4. Find the polluter
5. Name the cause and fix it at the root
6. Prove it

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Which cause to fix first

## Quality checks
- Fisher test on before/after
- the exposing stressor now passes

## Common failures
- Rate 0 after 50 runs: trigger not present on this machine

## Limitations
- nofile stressor is POSIX-only; TZ handling differs on Windows

## Reproducible example
examples/make_examples.py projects (order dependency, month-end, timezone, sleep race).
